title: Benchmark expansion and portable replay
objective: Expand the formalization benchmark while preserving reproducible Lean/Mathlib evidence and data/program separation.

in_scope: M1 benchmark contracts, Lean proofs, negative corpus, validators, replay evidence

deliverables.name: Benchmark contract expansion
deliverables.acceptance: Add a versioned M1 benchmark manifest with at least 5 new cases and explicit proof/negative mappings.

deliverables.name: Lean proof slice
deliverables.acceptance: Every M1 positive declaration compiles under the locked Lean and Mathlib revisions.

deliverables.name: Negative corpus slice
deliverables.acceptance: At least 2 distinct negative checks compile and are referenced by the manifest.

deliverables.name: Independent contract verifier
deliverables.acceptance: A verifier detects missing fields, duplicate IDs, missing declarations, and unregistered data paths without invoking the proof build.

deliverables.name: Replay evidence
deliverables.acceptance: A replay command validates M1 inputs, runs the focused build, and emits hash-bound evidence.
